title: Star Wars Topps Galactic Adversaries GA-7 Jyn Erso, Lucasfilm
descriptionText: The product is a Star Wars Topps Galactic Adversaries trading card featuring the character Jyn Erso from the Star Wars franchise. Manufactured by Topps in 2021, the card number is GA-7. It is a non-sport trading card that is part of the Galactic Adversaries set, highlighting different characters from the Star Wars universe. This collectible item appeals to fans of the Star Wars series looking to add unique and rare trading cards to their collection.
